verdictBody: All three indicators remain well below trigger. Continued and initial claims are still hovering near their 2026 lows, though payroll growth has slowed sharply — nonfarm gains averaged only +29K in September after a downwardly revised -10K in July.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Official IUR held near 1.1% for the week of Sep 5, matching last month's reading as continued claims stayed close to their 2026 low.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims eased to a fresh 2026 low of 1.699M in mid-September before ticking back up to 1.716M (week of Sep 26), even as payroll growth nearly stalled (+29K in Sept., a revised -10K in July).

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims extended their decline to 197K (week of Oct 3), the lowest reading in months and still far from trigger.

stats.label: Continued Claims
stats.note: Ticked up after a 2026 low of 1.699M in mid-Sept.
